projectDescription: Alchemetryx brand identity and strategy documentation — covering visual standards, messaging frameworks, ICP definitions, and positioning guidelines for the organisation.
keyFeatures: Brand Foundation — mission, vision, values, and origin story
Visual Identity System — logo, color palette, typography, and imagery guidelines
Tone of Voice & Messaging Framework — how Alchemetryx speaks and what it stands for
Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) — firmographic, demographic, and psychographic definitions
Buyer Personas — detailed profiles of decision-makers and champions
Jobs-to-be-Done & Pain Points — customer motivations mapped to solutions
Competitive Positioning — differentiation narrative and landscape overview
Value Proposition Canvas — clear articulation of customer value
Go-To-Market Strategy — channel mix, tactics, and content pillars
Brand Usage Guidelines — dos & don'ts, digital and print applications
